visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border on cards using the #E5E3DF color.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-xl for inner cards.
visual_enhancers.animation: Use Framer Motion for smooth layout transitions and pulsing states for active AI scans.

staff_avatar.description: Avatar for the care staff member

Concept_1.name: The Split Command Center
Concept_1.description: A 2-column Bento-style grid. The left column acts as a persistent sticky 'Progress Tracker' detailing the 4 steps. The right column is the dynamic 'Action Area' which currently displays the Confidentiality Review UI. This allows the user to perform tasks while keeping the overall progress context perfectly visible.
structure: Left Column (w-1/3): Contains Meeting Meta (Title, Avatars, Time) and a Vertical Stepper.
Vertical Stepper States: 1. Upload (Done), 2. Transcribe (Done), 3. Confidentiality Check (Active, Pulsing indicator), 4. Map Evidence (Processing, Spinner).
Right Column (w-2/3): Contains the Confidentiality Check tool.
Confidentiality Tool UI: A card showing '3 flags found'. Below it, 3 individual actionable cards showing the transcript snippet with highlighted PII. Buttons to 'Redact' or 'Keep'.

Concept_2.name: The Inline Action Stream
Concept_2.description: A unified, single-column vertical timeline layout. It feels like a story unfolding downwards. Completed steps collapse to save space, while the active step (Confidentiality) expands inline into an interactive widget. The background AI scanning step anchors the bottom.
structure: Header: 'Processing Meeting...' with global progress bar.
Step 1 & 2 Cards: Collapsed state, showing green checkmarks and a brief summary.
Step 3 Card (Expanded): Massive card with 'Confidentiality Check'. Features inline text with Terracotta highlighted words and inline floating action menus to Redact.
Step 4 Card (Pinned/Next): 'Mapping Compliance Evidence...' with a shimmering 'AI scanning' background gradient (using framer-motion) to indicate background activity.

mockup_instructions.routing: Create a unified page with a top-level Tab or Toggle component allowing the user to switch between 'Concept 1: Split View' and 'Concept 2: Inline Stream'.
mockup_instructions.interactivity: Mock the states so Step 1 and 2 are always 'Completed'. Step 3 should be 'Action Required' (Interactive UI for redaction). Step 4 should be 'Processing in Background' with animation.
components_needed: Lucide Icons: CheckCircle, Loader2, ShieldAlert, FileText, Mic
styling_rules: Follow the 'Generous Spacing Philosophy'. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
Use framer-motion for the pulsing AI scan effects in Step 4.
The highlighted PII text should have a soft background (e.g., bg-[#D47753]/10) and bold text color (#D47753).

universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do not use default generic blue. Stick to the Archetype 1 palette defined above.
Ensure the layout does not break when scaling down. Use responsive grid-cols.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons and interactive elements.
